services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: Safety and security. Professionally trained captains. A wide selection of helicopters. Corporate Helicopters’ charter services allow you to meet tight schedules by avoiding traffic congestion and crowded airport terminals. A helicopter tour from Corporate Helicopters is perfect for special occasions, business networking, romantic dates, family fun, real estate research and more. With a San Diego location, wholly-owned helicopters, Part 61 training, a maintenance center, a flight simulator, and a highly experienced staff, Corporate Helicopters is a unique helicopter school and flight training academy. blurb: Corporate Helicopters offers helicopter tours, charters, flight training, sales of new and pre-owned AIRBUS helicopters, aerial filming, and specialized aerial photography. They provide services throughout Southern California, the Western United States, and Mexico. Their flight training includes FAA Part 61 training, advanced training, and a flight simulator.

quotes.text: The experience was amazing! My fiance surprised me with the helicopter tour and chose the Romance In The Air package. We were given champagne and a box of chocolates. Terry, our pilot, was really great! He was accommodating and very fun to have along our experience. The helicopter ride was not bumpy at all and was smooth on a sunny day. The tour lasted around 30 minutes. Everything was planned greatly and everything went as planned.

My experience from initial enrollment to completion of my training, Corporate Helicopters has been nothing short of absolute excellence. The atmosphere and environment provided by the staff and CFI’s consistently maintained the utmost level of professionalism, always keeping safety a top priority. Lessons were concise and well integrated into the current publications for Helicopter/Rotorcraft Aviation.…
